name: Ontario

flag.description: A red ensign: a red field with the Union Jack in the upper hoist and the provincial shield in the fly, showing a red St George's cross above three gold maple leaves on green.
flag.symbolism: The Union Jack reflects Ontario's British heritage, and the shield, granted in 1868, pairs the cross of St George with maple leaves for Canada.

hook: Ontario is a red ensign with three gold maple leaves on its shield; Manitoba's red ensign has a bison instead.
trivia: Ontario adopted its red ensign in 1965, the same year the Maple Leaf replaced the Canadian Red Ensign as the national flag.
Ontario is home to almost two in every five Canadians.
